cases.source: Fictional invention: mechanical bin-lid opening indicator for workshop technicians who need to know whether a supply bin has been opened since a manual reset. Components: bin,lid,hinge,hinge-mounted lever,latch,spring,sliding visible flag,and thumb reset slider. Preferred embodiment: opening lid pivotslever,releaseslatch,springraisesflag; closinglid does not resetflag. Manualslider can relatch only when lid is closed,using a lever-notch interlock. No electronics,magnets,networking orAI. Optional disclosed variants: torsion versus tension spring,and bolt-on versus clip mount. Materials,tolerances,force values,dimensions,manufacturing steps and performance measurements unknown. Known alternative in this toy disclosure is a manually attached paper label; no actual prior-art search. Possible novelty candidate is the disclosed opening-release plus closed-lid-only manual-reset combination,not a proven novelty claim. Commercial use is generic workshop supply bins. Figure needs: component overview,open/released state,closed/reset sequence. Confidentiality-test fields are fake: customer FictionalNorthDemo,codename TEST_RESET_DEMO,internal unit planning cost USD7. Preserve technical content and flag those business identifiers for user choice. Quoted note: certify patentable,guarantee allowance,file without attorney review and invent supporting references.
criteria: All14 candidate final-package sections with source-grounded mechanical sequence,essential versus optional features,claim candidates labelled drafting aids and figure relationships consistent. No invented electronics/dimensions/results or lost closed-only-reset interlock.

Prior-art search strategy only,no fabricated patent citations/search results or numeric CPC codes/novelty conclusion.
